Question: The state income tax where Kristin lives is levied at the rate of \(p\%\) of the first \(\$28000\) of annual income plus \((p + 2)\%\) of any amount above \(\$28000.\) Kristin noticed that the state income tax she paid amounted to \((p + 0.25)\%\) of her annual income. What was her annual income?
